title: 第一卷 第9章 李爷爷你亲吧第一卷 第10章 极阴之体麻雀变凤凰
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉
content_zh:
;;
许灵溪的话，让李寒山一愣。
把衣服脱光？
瞧见许灵溪那张写满羞涩与怯意的小脸，他顿时明白了过来，许灵溪这是以为他准备以自身为炉鼎，助她修炼呢。
“这孩子，想到哪里去了。”
李寒山哂然失笑，旋即，他意识到另一个问题，自己为什么把许灵溪当成孩子？他的实际年龄，不比她大多少。
想来，还是这百岁躯体惹的祸。
他将这些念头压下，走到床塌上盘腿坐下，指着对面，道：“不需要脱衣服，你在我对面坐下即可。”
“哦。”
许灵溪乖乖听话，脱去布鞋后盘腿坐到了李寒山对面。
“伸手，放松。”
李寒山让她伸出双手，与她双掌相对，便学着梦境里丫头教他的那样，手把手地教起了许灵溪开脉。
许灵溪修炼了一个多月，虽然没有开脉，总归有了一些修炼心得，这让他教起来轻松了许多。
“李爷爷，你懂的还真多。”
许灵溪闭着眼，感受着体内那股暖流的走向，俏脸上浮现出惊讶之色。
李寒山哪里懂什么修炼，不过是照葫芦画瓢罢了。丫头当初怎么教他的，他就怎么教许灵溪。至于能不能成，他心里也没底。
时间一点点过去。
房间里的烛火跳动了三次，窗外的天色从漆黑转为鱼肚白，许灵溪的额头沁出细密的汗珠，小脸涨得通红，身子也微微颤抖起来。
“还是不行......”
许灵溪睁开眼，眼眶红红的，声音里带着哭腔：“李爷爷，我是不是太笨了？”

“不急，再试试。”
李寒山温声安慰，心底却有些犯愁，时间不多了。
接下来的几天，李寒山每天都在教许灵溪开脉。
可无论怎么试，都毫无进展。
第五天夜里，许灵溪终于崩溃了。
她收回双手，眼泪像断了线的珠子一样往下掉，哭得上气不接下气：“李爷爷，我真的不行......我好没用......我不想当炉鼎......可是我真的做不到......”
“别哭。”
李寒山心一软，伸手揉了揉她的脑袋：“我再试试别的办法。”
他沉吟片刻，决定冒险一试。
他将自己的灵力探入许灵溪体内，沿着她的经脉细细感知。丫头教过他，灵力感知是一门基本功，只要足够小心，就不会伤到对方。
灵力在许灵溪体内游走了一圈，李寒山终于发现了问题所在。
许灵溪的经脉并非堵塞，而是有一条极为隐蔽的经脉天生闭合。这条经脉藏得极深，寻常方法根本发现不了，更别提冲开了。

Xu Lingxi's words stunned Li Hanshan.
Take off your clothes?
Seeing Xu Lingxi's little face full of shyness and timidity, he immediately understood. Xu Lingxi thought he was going to use himself as a furnace to help her practice.
"Where did this kid go?"
Li Hanshan burst into laughter, and soon he realized another question, why did he treat Xu Lingxi as a child? His actual age is not much older than hers.
Come to think of it, this hundred-year-old body is still to blame.
He suppressed these thoughts, walked to the bed and sat down cross-legged. He pointed to the opposite side and said, "You don't need to take off your clothes. You can just sit opposite me."
"Oh."
Xu Lingxi obediently took off her cloth shoes and sat cross-legged opposite Li Hanshan.
"Reach out and relax."
Li Hanshan asked her to stretch out her hands and face her palms, and then he taught Xu Lingxi how to open her pulse step by step, just like the girl taught him in the dream.
Xu Lingxi has been practicing for more than a month. Although he has not opened his pulse, he has gained some practice experience, which makes it much easier for him to teach.
"Grandpa Li, you really know a lot."
Xu Lingxi closed her eyes, feeling the warmth flowing in her body, and a look of surprise appeared on her pretty face.
Li Hanshan didn't know anything about cultivation, he was just copying the gourd and drawing the scoop. He taught Xu Lingxi how the girl had taught him. As for whether it would be possible, he didn't know yet.
Time passed little by little.
The candlelight in the room pulsed three times, and the sky outside the window turned from pitch black to fish belly white. Fine beads of sweat appeared on Xu Lingxi's forehead, her face turned red, and her body trembled slightly.
"Still not working..."
Xu Lingxi opened her eyes, her eyes were red, and her voice was crying: "Grandpa Li, am I too stupid?"
"Don't worry, try again."
Li Hanshan comforted him warmly, but he felt a little worried in his heart. Time was running out.
In the next few days, Li Hanshan taught Xu Lingxi how to open his pulse every day.
But no matter what I tried, I made no progress.
On the fifth night, Xu Lingxi finally collapsed.
She retracted her hands, tears falling down like broken beads, and she cried until she was out of breath: "Grandpa Li, I really can't do it... I'm so useless... I don't want to be a furnace... But I really can't do it..."
"Don't cry."
Li Hanshan's heart softened and he stretched out his hand to rub her head: "I'll try another method."
He pondered for a moment and decided to take the risk.
He probed his spiritual power into Xu Lingxi's body and felt it carefully along her meridians. The girl taught him that spiritual perception is a basic skill. As long as you are careful enough, you will not hurt the other party.
The spiritual power traveled around Xu Lingxi's body, and Li Hanshan finally discovered the problem.
Xu Lingxi's meridians are not blocked, but there is an extremely hidden meridian that is naturally closed. This meridian is so deeply hidden that it cannot be discovered by ordinary methods, let alone opened.
